title: What changed in openstatus: 21–28 October
body:
The team digest for 21–28 October is ready: https://github.com/openstatusHQ/openstatus/blob/changes-data/2026-10-28.json

17 of 30 merged pull requests are in it. Routed and composed by claude-sonnet-5-5 (router) and claude-sonnet-5-5 (composer), via Claude Code.

First pass: no — 1 repair (1 composition, 0 illustrator); checks fired: composition (1)
Pictures: 7 for 17 changes; 13 of 20 speaking beats pictured, at most 2 in a row without one
